title: %stdSample — sample standard deviation
purpose: Compute the sample standard deviation (n−1 denominator) of a numeric array.
notes: Divides the summed squared deviations by n−1 (Bessel's correction), so it exceeds %std on the same data.
A two-element array [10, 20] gives sqrt(50) = ~7.071; a single-element array yields ~ (null).
